CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinate (red) is listed and the same referent has an explicit origin/representation record, satisfying C+O+D binding.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to an identified content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple literal entries identify content coordinates with color attributes at explicit referents and times.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content coordinates and an explicit origin/representation status for the same referent, distinguishing content from its access/organization status.

O.rationale: The text states a display/layout rule and gives explicit origin/representation metadata describing how content is represented/accessed.
